description: Increase in ground levels to rear garden and changes to boundary treatments at rear (PART RETROSPECTIVE).
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:AT1326-07ELM/MM/1001AT1326-05AT1326-06AT1326-03AT1326-04AT1326-01AT1326-02Planning StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Within three months of the date of this permission, the approved landscaping scheme, including the planting beds along each side boundary of the rear garden, hedging to a minimum height of 1.3m, and removal of the existing fencing where indicated, shall be implemented in full accordance with Drawing No. AT1326-02. Thereafter, the approved landscaping shall be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development. Should any of the landscaping die or be severely damaged it must be replaced in accordance with the approved plans. Reason: To safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers by ensuring adequate boundary screening to prevent overlooking.
